HOSTING_TOPOLOGY_CODES.doc: The hosting codes of the topology dimension: hosting.topology.*, the verdict and refusal codes a qualifier, a host or the console write and read by code, never by prose (docs/data-layout.md).

topologyAmbisonicConfig.doc: an ambisonic port refuses the carrier's ordering or normalisation

topologyChannelMapUnknown.doc: a surround port names a channel id the host does not know, or refuses the carrier's channel mask

topologyNoAudioInput.doc: the plugin has no audio input

topologyNoAudioOutput.doc: the host has nothing of the plugin to carry: a CLAP plugin with an audio input or an auxiliary port and no main output, an LV2 plugin with no port at all (any other plugin with no audio output is hosted as a pass-through tool)

topologyPortTooWide.doc: a port of more channels than the limit, or an ambisonic port whose channels are not (order+1)²

topologyTooManyPorts.doc: more than the limit of auxiliary ports on one side, or more than one main port on a side

topologyWiderThanStrip.doc: a main port is wider than the lane the caller runs the plugin on
